# BEIR SciFact

*Generated by `scripts/gen_bench_pages.py` from the `oml-bench/1` results in `eval/bench/results/`; do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `python scripts/gen_bench_pages.py`, and CI fails when this page differs from what it writes.*

Suite `beir-scifact`, data `beir/scifact/test (ir_datasets 0.6.3)`: 5,183 memories, 300 queries; a method marked sampled asked a seeded subset, named in its row. Measured 2026-11-05 on commit `ac57cd8`, `d3fdb72`; build release, host 8 vCPU / 15 GB, postgres 17.9.

[All suites](index.md)

## Limits of this run

- Offline bm25s over the same memories (Lucene BM25, English stop words, Snowball stems), not a served path; One abstract per memory as '<title>. <text>' (BEIR indexes two fields); k 100, no token budget; English only.
- One abstract per memory as '<title>. <text>' (BEIR indexes two fields); k 100, no token budget; English only.
- One abstract per memory as '<title>. <text>' (BEIR indexes two fields); k 100, no token budget; English only. Asked with k 10, the size an agent asks, to measure latency at that k; recall@100 reads the shorter list.
- One abstract per memory as '<title>. <text>' (BEIR indexes two fields); k 100, no token budget; English only. bm25-postings takes its candidates from the postings of the query forms it reads; when a query's readable postings pass POSTING_BUDGET (10,000) it leaves out the forms held by more than 10% of the readable rows, so a row holding only those is no candidate, and below the budget it reads every form and ranks as bm25 (ADR-0052 d6).
